About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

title: Senior Business Development Manager - Dissemination & Distribution
description:
If you're a driven sales professional with deep roots in the asset management sector and a passion for connecting clients to the data solutions they depend on, this is a rare opportunity to own and shape a high-growth territory across DACH and Central Europe.

As Senior Business Development Manager, you'll take the lead on one of FE fundinfo's most strategically important regions, bringing our Dissemination & Distribution solutions to asset managers, fund promoters, platforms and data vendors across Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Central Europe. This is a role where your market knowledge, client relationships and commercial instincts will directly influence product direction, go-to-market strategy, and the growth of a business that sits at the heart of the fund distribution ecosystem. You'll work alongside talented colleagues across sales, product and client success, with the backing of a dedicated BDR team and marketing function.

Your key responsibilities as a Senior Business Development Manager will include:

  • Owning and executing the sales strategy for our Dissemination and Distribution solutions across asset managers and fund promoters in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Central Europe.
  • Driving pipeline growth and bookings through programmatic execution of the DACH and Central Europe go-to-market plan, including cross-sell and new name sales plays.

  • Partnering with marketing and a dedicated BDR team to drive demand, and representing FE fundinfo at industry events across the DACH and Central European markets.
  • Collaborating with Client Success Managers to deliver a seamless post-sales experience and with product teams to bring client insight into the roadmap.

title: Sales Development Senior Manager
description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company.We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Sales Development Senior Manager to join our Sales team in Berlin! 

This is a hybrid role, requiring a minimum of two days per week in our office.

YOUR IMPACT

title: Junior Customer Success Specialist (m/f/x)
description:
Your mission

Purpose of the role

The Junior Customer Success Manager keeps single-store restaurants live, transacting and growing on SIDES. The role works a large book of scaled accounts, mostly through campaigns and signals rather than scheduled calls, and steps in personally when something moves: a store goes silent, a termination arrives, a customer becomes eligible for an upgrade.

It is the entry point into Customer Success. The role is built so that someone new to SaaS can learn the craft on clear processes, and grow into owning a book of their own.

Key responsibilities:

Activation and activity:

  • Follow up on new accounts from onboarding handover until they transact regularly, with a focus on the first 90 days
  • Work the silent-store list every week: accounts that are online in the CRM but show no transactions
  • Help customers adopt the modules they already pay for

Retention:

  • Contact every customer in the book whose termination arrives, within two working days, and document the reason
  • Run the first save conversation using the save playbook (pause, downgrade, fee removal, technical fix, discount last) and hand complex cases to a senior colleague
  • Clear the termination date in the CRM when a save succeeds

Expansion:

  • Run the evergreen upsell campaigns on the book together with Marketing, and follow up on responses
  • Qualify interest in SIDES Pay, webshop, loyalty and driver modules and close standard upgrades
  • Use tier and rate changes as the entry point for an upsell conversation

Day to day:

  • Answer customer success enquiries on the book in Zoho Desk and the CRM, and route pure support issues to Support without taking them over
  • Keep every interaction documented in the CRM
  • Flag recurring product issues to the Team Lead with ticket references

title: Associate Product Owner
description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we're looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.

Je leidt elke nieuwe klant naar live: het onboardinggesprek, het vastleggen van de processen en het inrichten van de AI.       Je bent eigenaar van de AI-kwaliteit. Je leest mee met wat de AI schrijft, ziet waar het beter kan en past de instructies aan.       Je stuurt een klein team aan: twee customer success managers in Leeuwarden en een supportteam in Suriname.       Je houdt de cijfers bij: tevredenheid, doorlooptijden en de gezondheid van elk account.      Wie je bent      Je hebt ervaring in klantenservice of customer success, bij voorkeur in e-commerce.       Je bent kritisch. Je ziet het verschil tussen een antwoord dat klopt en een antwoord dat goed is.       Je neemt zelf beslissingen en legt vast hoe iets moet, zodat het de volgende keer vanzelf goed gaat.       Je voelt je thuis aan tafel bij een merk en op de werkvloer met je team.       Je bent nieuwsgierig naar AI en wilt ermee werken, niet ertegen.      Wat je krijgt      Winstdeling. Groeien onze klanten en blijven ze, dan zie je dat terug.       Een rol die met je meegroeit. Elke nieuwe groep klanten krijgt een eigen customer success manager, en jij bouwt dat team op.       Werken met de nieuwste AI. Geen proef of pilot, maar productie: jouw oordeel maakt de AI elke dag beter, voor duizenden gesprekken tegelijk.       Timing. We staan aan het begin van de volgende groeifase. Wie nu instapt, bepaalt hoe die eruitziet.       Start: oktober 2026. Direct beschikbaar is een pluspunt.

description: 플렉스팀의 Account Management Lead는 Account Management 팀을 이끌며, 고객 유지와 확장 성장 전반을 책임지는 리더입니다.      AM팀은 성격이 다른 두 고객 테리토리를 담당합니다.        하나는 Mid-Market 이상 규모의 Key Account로, 제품을 중심으로 복잡한 이해관계자 구조 속에서 데이터 기반으로 고객 여정을 설계하고 갱신·확장을 리딩해야 하는 고객군입니다.     다른 하나는 조직 규모는 SMB지만 HR Partners/Payroll Partners 등 People Service가 결합되어 대표·C-level과 직접 소통하며 복합 서비스 계약을 비즈니스 관점에서 조율해야 하는 고객군입니다. Deine Mission

Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen.

Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde.
Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben.

Warum es diese Stelle gibt: Wir bringen ein neues Produkt an den Start, das unseren Partnerbetrieben einen konkreten Engpass löst. Technisch ist es fertig. Was jetzt zählt, ist die Einführung — und die passiert nicht über eine Mail. Sie passiert in Gesprächen.

Deine Aufgabe: Diese Gespräche führen. Du bekommst eine Einarbeitung und einen Gesprächsleitfaden. Nach acht Wochen sollte auch dieser Leitfaden noch besser sein, weil du hundert Gespräche geführt hast. Wer nur die Liste abarbeiten will, ist hier falsch. Wer wartet, bis jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt, auch.

Wohin die Rolle wächst: Sie startet fokussiert: ein Produkt, ein definierter Partnerkreis, ein Gespräch nach dem anderen. Sie ist aber nicht als Telefonjob angelegt, sondern als Einstieg ins Partner Management — eigene Partner, Ende zu Ende, von Erstkontakt bis laufender Betreuung. Wie schnell das geht, hängt an dir, nicht an einem Kalender.

Konkret:

  • ANRUFEN, NICHT ABTELEFONIEREN: Du stellst das neue Produkt bei Bestandspartnern vor. Nicht Skript vom Blatt, sondern ein Gespräch, das beim Gegenüber ankommt.
  • DEN PITCH WEITERENTWICKELN: Du merkst, welcher Einstieg funktioniert und welcher Einwand immer wieder kommt. Du behältst das nicht für dich, du änderst den Leitfaden.
  • ZUHÖREN UND ZURÜCKSPIELEN: Was Partner am Telefon sagen, ist die ehrlichste

Account Manager는 담당 고객사의 매출 성장과 리텐션을 직접 책임지면서, 동시에 고객사가 아임웹을 더 깊이 활용해 다음 성장을 만들어내도록 돕는 역할입니다. 고객사의 GMV가 곧 우리의 성과 지표이며, 활용 깊이를 만드는 일과 매출을 만드는 일을 한 사람이 함께 책임지기에, 단기 매출과 장기적인 신뢰 관계를 동시에 만들어갈 수 있습니다.      [주요 업무] 이런 역할을 기대하고 있어요    담당 고객사 포트폴리오의 매출과 운영 현황, 활용 지표를 분석하여 성장 기회와 이탈 리스크에 대응합니다.  고객사의 비즈니스 단계와 페인포인트에 맞춰 아임웹의 기능과 데이터를 어떻게 더 잘 활용할 수 있을지 제안하고, 정기 미팅을 통해 실행을 지원합니다.  활용도와 비즈니스 확장 시점을 가장 가까이에서 포착해 추가 기능과 서비스 도입을 제안하고, 업셀링과 크로스셀링으로 연결합니다.  이전 고객사의 온보딩을 리드하여, 도입 초기에 아임웹의 핵심 가치를 빠르게 경험하고 자기 비즈니스에 자리잡을 수 있도록 돕습니다.  계약 갱신과 재계약 협상을 직접 리드하며, 장기 파트너십을 통한 리텐션을 책임집니다.  고객사의 VOC와 페인포인트를 구조화해 프로덕트, CX 팀에 전달하며, 제품과 서비스 개선의 브리지 역할을 수행합니다.  잘 성장하고 있는 고객사의 사례를 발굴해 콘텐츠와 레퍼런스로 만들고, 마케팅, 세일즈 팀과 함께 다른 고객사로 확산시킵니다.    [자격 요건] 이런 분을 찾고 있어요    B2B SaaS 또는 IT 환경에서 Account Manager, Customer Success, 고객 컨설팅 등 고객 접점 직무에서 5년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분  다수의 중, 대형 고객 포트폴리오를 운영하며 매출 성장과 리텐션, 업셀링에서 의미 있는 성과를 만들어내신 분  고객사의 비즈니스를 깊이 이해하고, 데이터를 기반으로 컨설팅에 가까운 제안을 해보신 분  Spreadsheet, BI 툴 등으로 직접 데이터를 분석하고, 협상과 제안의 근거로 활용하시는 분  고객사 의사결정자와 신뢰감 있게 소통하고, 다양한 이해관계자와 능숙하게 협업하시는 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경에 유연하게 적응하시는 분       [우대 사항] 이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋아요    이커머스, 호스팅, 결제, CRM, 광고 솔루션 등 인접 SaaS 도메인 경험이 있으신 분  신규 영업의 협상과 계약부터 온보딩, 확장까지 풀 사이클을 경험해보신 분  CRM 또는 BI 툴을 적극적으로 활용해본 경험이 있으신 분  데이터 기반의 업셀링, 크로스셀링 시나리오를 직접 설계해 매출 성과를 만들어본 경험이 있으신 분  중형과 대형 고객사를 대상으로 한 정기 비즈니스 리뷰와 컨설팅 운영 경험  활용 데이터를 기반으로 이탈을 예측하거나 확장 기회를 발견해본 경험  D2C 브랜드, 쇼핑몰, 마켓플레이스 등 이커머스 생태계에 대한 깊은 이해       [합류 과정]      전형 프로세스  : 서류 전형 > 1차 직무 인터뷰 > 2차 컬처 애드 (Culture Add) 인터뷰 > 최종 합격   서류 전형  : 생년월일, 사진, 연봉 정보 등 업무와 관계없는 내용보다, 어떤 경험을 해오셨는지 알 수 있는 경력 위주로 지원서를 작성해주세요.   직무 인터뷰  : 앞으로 함께 근무할 팀원들과 직무와 관련된 이야기를 나누는 시간이에요. 과제 테스트를 진행했을 경우 테스트에 대한 피드백도 나누고 있어요.   컬쳐 애드 인터뷰  : 피플팀 리드와 45분, CEO 수모님과 30분 정도 이야기를 나누며 지원자님의 조직문화 적합성뿐만 아니라 아임웹의 문화에 더해줄 수 있는 가치를 확인하는 시간이에요.
